content.title: Live Stream Lester Martinez vs Immanuwel Aleem: How to Watch Boxing
content.text: Undefeated Lester Martinez will touch gloves with Immanuwel Aleem for the chance to take on Christian Mbilli for the WBC Super Middleweight Title. Lester Martinez will step into the ring with Immanuwel Aleem in San Bernardino, California, on Saturday night at the National Orange Show Event Center, each looking for a coveted win in this high-stakes boxing match for the WBC Interim Super Middleweight Title. In the right corner, Martinez is a Guatemalan-born boxer with a 19-0-1 record and a massive 16 knockouts. The 30-year-old middleweight boxer stands at 5-foot-8 with a 71.5-inch reach. Martinez’s name goes before him as he presents an 80% knockout rate in his boxing matches. Martinez suffered the only split of his career in his last fight in September of 2025 against Christian Mbilli — a fight that went 10 rounds and ended in a split decision that allowed Mbilli to retain his title. How to Watch Lester Martinez vs Immanuwel Aleem Today: Match Date: Saturday, Mar. 21, 2026 Match Time: 8:00 p.m. ET TV Channel: fubo Sports Network Location: National Orange Show Event Center, San Bernardino, CA Live stream Lester Martinez vs Immanuwel Aleem on Fubo: Start Watching Today! In the left corner, Aleem is an eager competitor, looking to continue making a name for himself. The 32-year-old has more matches to his name than Martinez, but a mixture of results. Aleem is 22-3-3 in his career with 14 knockouts in those 22 wins and one knockout in his three losses. Aleem stands at 5-foot-9 with a 70-inch reach, but he boasts only a 63% knockout rate. His last fight was in July, where he took down Demond Nicholson in the Universal Boxing Organization Intercontinental Light Heavyweight. With the current WBC Interim Super Middleweight Title vacant, the winner of this match will get the opportunity to take on Christian Mbilli in a mandatory fight that will crown the new belt title holder.
